miniapp.name: Phuzzles
miniapp.subtitle: Photos you have to solve
miniapp.description: Turn a photo into a puzzle and post it. Whoever puts the pieces back sees the picture and the note you left under it. There is a new puzzle every day too.
miniapp.tagline: Post a photo as a puzzle
miniapp.ogDescription: Post a photo as a puzzle. Whoever solves it gets to see it.
